extracted_text: Initialize this repository for an enterprise-grade automated talking-head video generation platform. The product lets an authenticated user enter a short text, article, or opinion, then automatically produces a publish-ready short-form video. The system must support authorized voice profiles for zero-shot or few-shot voice cloning TTS, digital human rendering with lip sync and natural head motion, structured script and storyboard planning, HTML/Remotion-style dynamic scene animation, subtitles, background music, quality inspection, automatic repair, fallback strategies, and final MP4 rendering for vertical social video. This is not an MVP or demo; design the collaboration workspace for a production-grade, enterprise-usable system with reliability, observability, multi-tenant asset management, consent and audit logs, GPU worker orchestration, object storage, task resumability, quality gates, and model adapters that can use mostly open-source/local models with minimal third-party APIs. The architecture should favor segment-based generation, deterministic scene DSL rather than arbitrary generated code, and clear fallback paths for TTS, avatar generation, subtitle alignment, HTML rendering, and final composition. Create a coordinating master task and first-wave child tasks for architecture, model-service integration, orchestration, quality-control, product/API surface, infrastructure, and security/compliance. Stop after repository initialization; do not implement code yet.
